Archived GFS air temperature and cloud cover forecasts near Whychus Creek

Source: R/data.R
dynamical_gfs_forecasts.Rd

Historical NOAA Global Forecast System output for the grid cell nearest Whychus Creek (lat 44.390278, lon -121.406792), at forecast leads of one to seven days. This is the weather archive the RM 8.5 forecast models are trained on.

Usage

dynamical_gfs_forecasts

Format

A data frame with columns:

valid_date

Date. The date the forecast value applies to.

issue_date

Date. The model initialisation date the forecast was issued on.

lead_days

Integer. Forecast lead time in days, 1 through 7.

variable

Character. Variable name: "temperature_2m_max", "temperature_2m_min", or "cloud_cover_mean".

value

Numeric. Variable value in the unit given by units.

units

Character. "°C" for temperature, "%" for cloud cover.

lat

Numeric. Latitude (44.390278).

lon

Numeric. Longitude (-121.406792).

Source

dynamical.org NOAA GFS forecast archive (s3://dynamical-noaa-gfs, region us-west-2), https://dynamical.org. Pulled by data-raw/pull_dynamical_forecasts.py.

Details

Unlike all_historical_forecasts, which stores a single value per issue date replicated across every lead, this dataset carries a distinct value at each lead, so a genuine day-1-through-day-7 forecast trajectory can be reconstructed for any issue date.

Values are calendar-day aggregates built from the model's four 6-hour windows, taken from the 00Z initialisation. Coverage begins 2021-05-01, the start of the dynamical.org GFS archive, and is seasonal thereafter — the pull targets the May-October forecast season.

The column names match all_historical_forecasts (minus its type column) so the two archives can be compared directly.
